'''Steps''' is a wolf.

== Appearance ==
Steps is a black-furred youth.

== Activities ==
Steps helps [[Perrin Aybara]] locate Heartseeker ([[Hessalam]]) in the [[wolf dream]].

== Trivia ==
* Steps is named for Jason Stevens, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
